title: Overnight-only holding of the equity calendar sleeves (T1, T2, FC, MM)
why: US equity index returns accrue mostly overnight (Cliff, Cooper and Gulen 2008; Kelly and Clark 2011); R1 excluded (its window was examined in Gen148)

variants.full: current: close of d-1 to close of d (daily_book)
variants.night: hourly roll-safe: from 16:00 ET on the trading day before an active day d to 09:00 ET on d (close of the 15:00 bar to close of the 08:00 bar), same 0.25 per index; 2 x cost_frac per round trip

selection: variant with the higher 2010-06..2022-12 Sharpe of the equal-weighted sum of the four sleeves
judgement: if night is chosen it replaces the four sleeves; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.102; adopt only if higher
